description: The scale-search tile sampler loops over width but never uses the inner-loop variable, so it appends the same tile width times for each outer-loop index.
trigger: g_scale_mse_gridsearch assembles its representative tile sample with width greater than one; the default width is 3.
expected_behavior: If width denotes sampling width, each inner-loop iteration would select a distinct neighboring tile; no contemporaneous contract confirming that interpretation was found.
actual_behavior: The column coordinate uses i + width rather than i plus the inner-loop variable, so every iteration selects the same wrapped-diagonal tile and appends it three times at the default width.

introductions.scope: Present in the repository root; suspected contract violation, not a confirmed defect.

observations.source: Commit 13 mailbox reviewer observation followed by independent root-tree source inspection.

verification.argument: w is bound by range(width) but never read; n depends on i + width only, so the inner loop clones, permutes and appends the same tile width times.
limits: No quantizer or performance benchmark was run.
Equal duplication leaves an unweighted mean unchanged, so no numerical search-result difference is established.
The extra sampling work appears to triple per-evaluation tile work at the default width, but runtime impact is unmeasured.
No source comment or external contract establishes whether width was intended to select distinct neighboring columns; status remains suspected.

impact.rationale: Equal duplication does not change the sampled mean, but it appears to repeat tile quantization work; supported-input reach and measured cost are not assessed.

administrative_review_status: Reviewer-identified suspected ledger candidate awaiting independent review; source inspected, not executed.
